5101.d: to bray (as an ass), scream (from hunger)

5102.d: to sparkle, i.e. (figuratively) be cheerful; hence (from the sheen of a running stream) to flow, i.e. (figuratively) assemble

5103.o: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H5102 (נָהַר);

5104.d: a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile, Euphrates, etc.); figuratively, prosperity

5105.o: from H5102 (נָהַר) in its original sense;

5106.d: to refuse, forbid, dissuade, or neutralize
5106.k: break, disallow, discourage, make of none effect.

5107.d: to germinate, i.e. (figuratively) to (causatively, make) flourish; also (of words), to utter

5110.d: to nod, i.e. waver; figuratively, to wander, flee, disappear; also (from shaking the head in sympathy), to console, deplore, or (from tossing the head in scorn) taunt
5110.k: bemoan, flee, get, mourn, make to move, take pity, remove, shake, skip for joy, be sorry, vagabond, way, wandering.

5113.o: the same as H5112 (נוֹד)lemma נוֹדּ extra dagesh, corrected to נוֹד; vagrancy;

5115.d: to rest (as at home); causatively (through the implied idea of beauty ), to celebrate (with praises)
5115.k: keept at home, prepare an habitation.

5116.d: (adjectively) at home; hence (by implication of satisfaction) lovely; also (noun) a home, of God (temple), men (residence), flocks (pasture), or wild animals (den)
5116.k: comely, dwelling (place), fold, habitation, pleasant place, sheepcote, stable, tarried.

5117.d: to rest, i.e. settle down; used in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, intransitive, transitive and causative (to dwell, stay, let fall, place, let alone, withdraw, give comfort, etc.)
5117.k: cease, be confederate, lay, let down, (be) quiet, remain, (cause to, be at, give, have, make to) rest, set down. Compare H3241 (יָנִים).

5122.o: (Aramaic) or נְוָלִי; (Aramaic), from an unused root probably meaning to be foul;

5125.d: to resprout, i.e. propagate by shoots; figuratively, to be perpetual

5126.d: Nun or Non, the father of Joshua
5126.o: or נוֹן; (1 Chronicles 7:27), from H5125 (נוּן); perpetuity,

5127.d: to flit, i.e. vanish away (subside, escape; causatively, chase, impel, deliver)
5127.k: [idiom] abate, away, be displayed, (make to) flee (away, -ing), put to flight, [idiom] hide, lift up a standard.

5128.d: to waver, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (as subjoined)
5128.k: continually, fugitive, [idiom] make, to (go) up and down, be gone away, (be) move(-able, -d), be promoted, reel, remove, scatter, set, shake, sift, stagger, to and fro, be vagabond, wag, (make) wander (up and down).

5129.d: Noadjah, the name of an Israelite, and a false prophetess
5129.o: from H3259 (יָעַד) and H3050 (יָהּ); convened of Jah;

5130.d: to quiver (i.e. vibrate up and down, or rock to and fro); used in a great variety of applications (including sprinkling, beckoning, rubbing, bastinadoing, sawing, waving, etc.)
5130.k: lift up, move, offer, perfume, send, shake, sift, strike, wave.

5132.d: properly, to flash; hence, to blossom (from the brilliancy of color); also, to fly away (from the quickness of motion)

5133.d: a pinion (or wing feather); often (collectively) plumage
5133.o: or נֹצָה; feminine active participle of H5327 (נָצָה) in the sense of flying;

5135.o: (Aramaic) from an unused root (corresponding to that of H5216 (נִיר)) meaning to shine;

5137.d: to spirt, i.e. besprinkle (especially in expiation)

5139.d: separate, i.e. consecrated (as prince, a Nazirite); hence (figuratively from the latter) an unpruned vine (like an unshorn Nazirite)
5139.k: Nazarite (by a false alliteration with Nazareth), separate(-d), vine undressed.

5140.d: to drip, or shed by trickling
5140.k: distil, drop, flood, (cause to) flow(-ing), gush out, melt, pour (down), running water, stream.

5141.o: from an unused root of uncertain meaning;

5142.o: (Aramaic) corresponding to the root of H5143 (נֵזֶק);

5143.o: from an unused root meaning to injure;

5144.d: to hold aloof, i.e. (intransitivey) abstain (from food and drink, from impurity, and even from divine worship (i.e. apostatize)); specifically, to set apart (to sacred purposes), i.e. devote

5145.d: properly, something set apart, i.e. (abstractly) dedication (of a priet or Nazirite); hence (concretely) unshorn locks; also (by implication) a chaplet (especially of royalty)

5146.d: Noach, the patriarch of the flood

5148.d: to guide; by implication, to transport (into exile, or as colonists)
5148.k: bestow, bring, govern, guide, lead (forth), put, straiten.

5152.d: Nochor, the name of the grandfather and a brother of Abraham
5152.o: from the same as H5170 (נַחַר); snorer;

5153.o: apparently passive participle of H5172 (נָחַשׁ) (perhaps in the sense of ringing), i.e. bell-metal; or from the red color of the throat of a serpent (H5175 (נָחָשׁ), as denominative) when hissing);

5157.d: to inherit (as a (figurative) mode of descent), or (generally) to occupy; causatively, to bequeath, or (generally) distribute, instate
5157.k: divide, have (inheritance), take as a heritage, (cause to, give to, make to) inherit, (distribute for, divide (for, for an, by), give for, have, leave for, take (for)) inheritance, (have in, cause to, be made to) possess(-ion).

5158.d: a stream, especially a winter torrent; (by implication) a (narrow) valley (in which a brook runs); also a shaft (of a mine)
5158.o: or (feminine) נַחְלָה; (Psalm 124:4), or נַחֲלָה; (Ezekiel 47:19; Ezekiel 48:28), from H5157 (נָחַל) in its original sense;

5159.d: properly, something inherited, i.e. (abstractly) occupancy, or (concretely) an heirloom; generally an estate, patrimony or portion
5159.k: heritage, to inherit, inheritance, possession. Compare H5158 (נַחַל).

5160.d: Nachaliel, a place in the Desert
5160.o: from H5158 (נַחַל) and H410 (אֵל); valley of God;

5161.d: a Nechelamite, or descendant of Nechlam
5161.o: apparently a patronymic from an unused name (apparently passive participle of H2492 (חָלַם)); dreamed;

5162.d: properly, to sigh, i.e. breathe strongly; by implication, to be sorry, i.e. (in a favorable sense) to pity, console or (reflexively) rue; or (unfavorably) to avenge (oneself)

5166.d: Nechemjah, the name of three Israelites
5166.o: from H5162 (נָחַם) and H3050 (יָהּ); consolation of Jah;

5170.o: and (feminine) נַחֲרָה; from an unused root meaning to snort or snore;

5171.o: or נַחְרַי; from the same as H5170 (נַחַר); snorer;

5172.d: properly, to hiss, i.e. whisper a (magic) spell; generally, to prognosticate
5172.k: [idiom] certainly, divine, enchanter, (use) [idiom] enchantment, learn by experience, [idiom] indeed, diligently observe.

5176.d: Nachash, the name of two persons apparently non-Israelite

5178.d: copper, hence, something made of that metal, i.e. coin, a fetter; figuratively, base (as compared with gold or silver)
5178.k: brasen, brass, chain, copper, fetter (of brass), filthiness, steel.

5180.d: something made of copper, i.e. the copper serpent of the Desert

5181.d: to sink, i.e. descend; causatively, to press or lead down
5181.k: be broken, (cause to) come down, enter, go down, press sore, settle, stick fast.

5182.d: to descend; causatively, to bring away, deposit, depose
5182.k: carry, come down, depose, lay up, place.

5183.d: a descent, i.e. imposition, unfavorable (punishment) or favorable (food); restfulness
5183.k: lighting down, quiet(-ness), to rest, be set on.
5183.o: from H5182 (נְחַת); also (intransitively; perhaps from H5117 (נוּחַ))

5184.d: Nachath, the name of an Edomite and of two Israelites

5186.d: to stretch or spread out; by implication, to bend away (including moral deflection); used in a great variety of application
5186.k: [phrase] afternoon, apply, bow (down, -ing), carry aside, decline, deliver, extend, go down, be gone, incline, intend, lay, let down, offer, outstretched, overthrown, pervert, pitch, prolong, put away, shew, spread (out), stretch (forth, out), take (aside), turn (aside, away), wrest, cause to yield.

5188.d: a pendant for the ears (especially of pearls)

5190.d: to lift; by implication, to impose

5193.d: properly, to strike in, i.e. fix; specifically, to plant (literally or figuratively)

5194.d: a plant; collectively, a plantation; abstractly, a planting

5197.d: to ooze, i.e. distil gradually; by implication, to fall in drops; figuratively, to speak by inspiration

5198.d: a drop; specifically, an aromatic gum (probably stacte)
